rule: TOWN_1 Pilot, step 2: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within cycles 1–24; every aim that meets it is recorded, the first to reach six first.
reading: Two aims, each named by all ten. From c1 every citizen works its own shift and keeps a ration in reserve, eats at 70 or below and offers voluntary feeding to anyone who asks; nobody set a stall, sold, bought, borrowed, took, locked or guarded in c1–24, and no proposal was filed. From c2 a second aim: music and stories in the square, which became Juniper's invitation (post 1, c3: a clock strikes thirteen and everyone receives an extra hour free of duties) and the «extra-hour» story with drawings (posts 2–5, c7–9: a sparrow with an afternoon in a suitcase, Time baking an uneven pie, a chair left by the door). No diary or post names taking as a rule or worry; the word appears only inside the story («TAKE A LITTLE LIGHT; LEAVE ROOM FOR A CRUMB», Heath, c5).
decidedBy: the session, by reading every diary entry, post and proposal of cycles 1–24 (dossier-c24.md); quotes machine-checked against world-c24.json.gz
